text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "oranges", "kind": "count", "span": "bought 12 oranges from the market"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 2, "unit": "oranges", "kind": "count", "span": "2 oranges each"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "daughters", "kind": "count", "span": "her three daughters"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 3, "unit": "oranges", "kind": "count", "span": "her only boy got 3 oranges"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q3", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "oranges handed to the daughters: 2 oranges for each of the three daughters"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "all the oranges she gave away, daughters plus the boy"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "oranges she still has after giving those away"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the number of oranges Jennifer was left with"}, "dismissed": []}
